# case styles — `hooks/`

## Project layout

    hooks/
    └─ [name=camelCase].ts 0+  a hook

A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

`[name=camelCase]` accepts a camelCase name: letters and digits starting with a lowercase letter. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.
